rows.resapp_quote: A PM opens BA_US_Equity and reads the Thesis ON ONE SCREEN under ONE dark band
rows.dsgn_quote: Investment thesis, Risks and Recommendation sit as three cards under the main chart
rows.ask: DSGN owns the Thesis as three cards under the main chart but not the ONE-dark-band layout: bandContainersTopLevel == 1 with the identity header as that band, white hairline tab panels, and a recommendation line plus summary paragraph and headed sections with evidence folded.

rows.dsgn_quote: The header holds no more than four cards -- Price, Financials, Market features, Trading technicals -- each leading with one figure and opening a window with the rest
rows.ask: DSGN promises four header cards, not six Stat tiles; it would need to own units and tabular numerals on each figure and a tooltip carrying the mnemonic and full-precision value verbatim so a PM can still dispute a figure, and say where price, market cap, net debt, EV, beta and short interest sit among the four cards.

rows.resapp_quote: Every drafted sentence keeps its evidence, folded until asked for

rows.ask: DSGN opens evidence in a window per card; it would need to own the per-sentence PASS face with a 'cites N passages' affordance, the passage and accession line rendered FROM THE DOM, the census of zero passages in a native title= tooltip with its positive control (non-zero denominator, application route), and preservation of the verbatim gate by construction.

rows.resapp_quote: The comparable set shows the columns that EXIST, and the absent ones are openable

rows.ask: Page-shaped (added row). DSGN promises missing columns explained once; it would need to own rendering PRESENT columns only, an 'Absent columns (N)' disclosure with each registry reason, and the basis as a status chip with the test statement one hover away.

rows.ask: Page-shaped (added row). DSGN owns the verdict card with numbered reasons; it would need to own the verdict as a Stat with the comparable beside it, cites folded, and an UNRESOLVED cite as a status.warning ICON beside navy text, never amber text (C6).

rows.resapp_quote: The Lead Panel's controls read as the Dashboard's controls do

rows.ask: DSGN owns footers reading as a time and a source and the estate's own pieces, but no outcome promises Movement and Subject as segmented controls whose active state is WEIGHT AND RULE, the generation and resolution lines in a 'Source:' footer, or purpleFills == 0 in Universe mode and == 1 (Refresh) in Security mode.

rows.ask: DSGN promises designed empty states only as same pieces as the finished pages (and Posture's empty state); it would need to own all four states PanelEmpty, PanelLoading, PanelError and PanelNoPermission from src/ui/components/states, each captured at least once across the six states, on every panel.

rows.resapp_quote: The contract's render check PASSES, and CAN FAIL
rows.ask: No DSGN outcome promises the MECHANICAL render check: ui-smoke PNG plus DOM measurement JSON per state (bandContainersTopLevel == 1, fonts == {Lato}, weights within {400,700}, no size below 11, radii, shadows == 0, lowContrastChars == 0, purpleFills) that reads today's page as failing each clause; DSGN FWD-11 is only a person's side-by-side read. Either DSGN owns this instrument or the mechanical-check capability is no longer promised.
